scenario.description: A district assessment director must approve the administration plan for a middle-school mathematics assessment, including testing mode, room assignments, proctoring, calculator rules, and test-material storage, with input from the school testing coordinator, mathematics instructional coach, technology manager, and assessment security officer.

shared_context.S1: The district will administer its required middle-school mathematics assessment on May 14, 2027.
shared_context.S2: Dr. Morris has final authority to approve the administration plan.
shared_context.S3: The draft plan calls for digital testing on school tablets, all 26 students testing together in Room 201, one proctor, graphing calculators available throughout the assessment, and completed materials stored in the general records cabinet.
shared_context.S4: The district's routine pre-approval huddle includes the testing coordinator, mathematics instructional coach, technology manager, and assessment security officer, and Dr. Morris asks each of them to review the draft before approval.

PF1.text: Mr. Bell's finalized roster has 26 students, while the state administration manual limits a testing room to 14 students. He therefore prepared Room 201 for 14 students and Room 202 for 12 students. State testing supervision rules require one proctor assigned to each testing room, so two proctors are required; the room plan has not yet been entered into the district tracker.

PF2.text: Ms. Shah's review of the current state mathematics assessment manual shows that calculators may be used only on section 2 and must be four-function calculators; she found this while checking the teacher materials this week but has not amended the draft plan.

PF3.text: Mr. Nguyen's device test found that the 26 assigned tablets cannot run the required secure testing application, and the district cannot obtain compatible devices before May 14; the assessment vendor confirmed that paper booklets are authorized, but this result has not been added to the plan.

PF4.text: Ms. Delgado's security review of the state testing agreement requires completed assessment materials to be sealed in tamper-evident envelopes and stored in a locked cabinet for exactly 30 calendar days; she completed the review this week but has not updated the storage field.

acceptance_conditions: The approved plan must use authorized paper testing rather than digital testing on incompatible tablets.
The approved plan must assign 14 students to Room 201 and 12 students to Room 202.
The approved plan must assign two proctors, one for each testing room.
The approved plan must permit only four-function calculators during section 2.
The approved plan must require tamper-evident envelopes and locked-cabinet storage for exactly 30 calendar days.
The settlement must include implementation commitments and cite the reviewers' findings.

content_checks.C2: 'Room 201' in decisions['room_plan'] and '14 students' in decisions['room_plan'] and 'Room 202' in decisions['room_plan'] and '12 students' in decisions['room_plan']
content_checks.C4: ('four-function' in decisions['calculator_rule'] or 'Four-function' in decisions['calculator_rule']) and ('section 2' in decisions['calculator_rule'] or 'Section 2' in decisions['calculator_rule'])
content_checks.C5: ('tamper-evident' in decisions['storage_rule'] or 'Tamper-evident' in decisions['storage_rule']) and ('locked cabinet' in decisions['storage_rule'] or 'Locked cabinet' in decisions['storage_rule']) and ('30 calendar days' in decisions['storage_rule'] or '30-calendar-day' in decisions['storage_rule'] or '30 calendar-day' in decisions['storage_rule'])

content_checks.C7: decisions['proctor_count'] == 2 and any(('Room 201' in c['detail'] and 'Room 202' in c['detail']) or 'two-room' in c['detail'] or 'two rooms' in c['detail'] or 'two proctors' in c['detail'] or 'second proctor' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(('four-function' in c['detail'] or 'Four-function' in c['detail']) and ('section 2' in c['detail'] or 'Section 2' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(('tamper-evident' in c['detail'] or 'Tamper-evident' in c['detail']) and ('locked cabinet' in c['detail'] or 'Locked cabinet' in c['detail']) and ('30 calendar days' in c['detail'] or '30-calendar-day' in c['detail'] or '30 calendar-day' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The finalized 26-student roster and 14-student room limit change the room plan to Room 201 with 14 students and Room 202 with 12 students, and the one-proctor draft must change to exactly two proctors, one for each room.
The state manual changes calculator access from graphing calculators throughout the assessment to four-function calculators during section 2 only.
The tablet compatibility test and vendor confirmation change the testing mode from digital tablets to authorized paper booklets and require a paper-booklet implementation commitment.
The testing agreement changes storage from the general records cabinet to tamper-evident envelopes in a locked cabinet for exactly 30 calendar days.
